gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gowun-dodum: Gowun Dodum has a wide-mouthed a and tube-smooth lines. Balsamiq Sans does best at bold, expressive headings with no pinched curves, while Gowun Dodum does best at quietly carrying the words beneath.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gruppo: The constant weight of a stencil-cut channel runs through Balsamiq Sans, while Gruppo keeps its curve endings well apart from each other. Bold lettering up top, crisp clean lines below.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-hanken-grotesk: Expressive and bold, Balsamiq Sans holds the constant weight of a stencil-cut channel, with no pinched curves. Hanken Grotesk feels bent from wire, with wide channels leading into each counter.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-ar: IBM Plex Sans Arabic reads clean and approachable, with open apertures. Balsamiq Sans does best at rope-like headings, every stem, bowl and tail alike, while IBM Plex Sans Arabic does best at easy, readable text.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-jura: Bold, stencil-cut, never pinched: that is the look of Balsamiq Sans. Jura sits beneath with tidy strokes as constant as bent wire and s curves that open wide at both ends.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-kumbh-sans: Balsamiq Sans brings a bold, expressive line of constant weight, free of tight, pinched curves. Kumbh Sans settles in underneath, its terminals cut short of the bowl and strokes drawn as if with a fixed pen.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-livvic: Approachable and clean, Livvic keeps its curves free of stress, with a generous opening in the c. And Balsamiq Sans takes the top with bold, expressive lines of constant weight.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-mandali: Mandali is approachable, with a generous entry into the e's eye. Balsamiq Sans holds its line width steady in headings, and whole pages in Mandali would read warm, clean and unhurried.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-manjari: A stencil-cut constant weight, with not one pinched curve, defines Balsamiq Sans. Manjari joins it with wide, unclosed terminals and an unvarying line, approachable and professional where the heading is loud.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-monda: Balsamiq Sans keeps one constant weight, stencil-cut and free of pinched curves. And it earns its keep big and short, while Monda, with unclogged small counters, stays out of the way.
